preconditions.description: The length of the string P is between 1 and 10^6.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^6.
The indices L and R are within the bounds of the string P.
The string P consists only of the characters 'c', 'h', 'e', and 'f'.
The characters a and b are different.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == count_good_strings(P, a, b, L, R) for i in range(Q)
postconditions.description: For each query, the output should be the count of good strings starting at a and ending at b, where the indices of the substring are between L and R.
